title: Codex host tests must reset their own failed systemd scopes
body: Codex host tests leave failed krn-* systemd scopes behind: on 2026-11-07 the user manager held 371 'loaded failed' krn-* units; one npm run fast over the 19 Codex-related tests added about 5 more and 5 parallel runs added 27. Acceptance: after a full test run, `systemctl --user list-units --all 'krn-*' --state=failed --no-legend | wc -l` is unchanged from before the run (tests reset-failed their own units in cleanup), with a test that asserts this for one launched scope.
